name: codex-sci-ppt
description: Create and rebuild scientific figures as editable PowerPoint graphics.

interface.longDescription: Codex Sci-PPT creates scientific schematics, locally analyzes clean reference images, provides reusable editable scientific templates including bamboo cross-sections and 5 x 2 x 0.5 cm bamboo boards, and reconstructs suitable raster diagrams without a third-party credit system.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Codex Sci-PPT to create or rebuild my scientific figure as editable PowerPoint objects.
